_doc.schema: Each overlay matches a single spoken word OR a phrase (case-insensitive). When Whisper detects a match, the overlay appears at that word's timestamp.
_doc.animations: pop-bounce | slide-in-left | slide-in-right | drop-bounce | fade-scale | rotate-in
_doc.positions: top-left | top-right | bottom-left | bottom-right | center | above-caption
_doc.lottie_src: Either a URL like https://lottie.host/abc123.json OR a path relative to remotion/public/ like 'lotties/money.json'
